name: Augur Pact, Greater
body:
School divination [pact]; Level bard 3, cleric 3, inquisitor 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3, witch 3

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as augur pact†, except you can submit the names of up to six spirits.
